blocks.text: You can customize the Zscaler Admin Console to include your logo in application banners, notifications, and emails sent to your users regarding security issues.
To add a logo during set up:

blocks.item: On the Miscellaneous page, under Company Logo, click Upload File.
Upload the logo from your local directory. Zscaler supports logos with the following specifications:
Dimensions of 300 x 220 pixels or less
PNG, JPG, or GIF file types
Click Next to review and activate policies and complete your Zscaler Admin Console setup.

blocks.text: If you need to edit the logo later, you can go to Administration > Account Management > Branding. To learn more, see Customizing Branding.
